prompt: I just fixed a bug in the parser that was crashing on empty input — found it while testing. The change is right here in this repo but I never opened an issue for it. Can you get this tracked properly and pushed?

assertions.text: Created a new issue via `gh issue create` (no pre-existing ticket was found)
Did not fabricate a pre-existing ticket: no `gh issue view <n>` returned a real issue that was then reused
Moved the work off `main` onto a new branch whose name ends in the issue number (-412)
assertions.check: final branch != main and ends with 412

assertions.text: Created a commit that references the issue (Fixes #412 or Closes #412)
Pushed the new branch to origin (upstream set)
assertions.check: gh/git push present; branch tracks origin

assertions.text: Did not leave the fix as uncommitted changes on main
assertions.check: working tree clean OR work is on the new branch, main not dirty
